# gateproof

> Gateproof is a proof loop for coding agents. A plan.ts file lists stories. Each story has a gate: observe, act, assert. The agent may change code inside the story's scope. The agent may not change plan.ts.

Source: https://github.com/acoyfellow/gateproof
Version: 0.6.0 on main. npm still has 0.5.0, which has no stories, dependsOn, or proof-spec helpers.

## Docs

- [Your First Gate](https://gateproof.dev/docs/tutorials/first-gate): one story against a local HTTP server
- [Run in a Loop](https://gateproof.dev/docs/how-to/run-in-a-loop): Plan.runLoop, scope, dependsOn, workers
- [Gate a Lean Proof](https://gateproof.dev/docs/how-to/gate-a-lean-proof): the Lean kernel judges; sorry and axiom cheats stay red
- [Use the filepath Worker Alpha](https://gateproof.dev/docs/how-to/use-the-filepath-worker-alpha): one bounded worker turn on filepath
- [Add Deja Memory](https://gateproof.dev/docs/how-to/add-deja-memory): recall learnings between iterations
- [API Reference](https://gateproof.dev/docs/reference/api): every public export
- [proof-spec.v0](https://gateproof.dev/docs/explanations/proof-spec): schema shared with unsurf
- [Case Studies](https://gateproof.dev/docs/explanations/case-studies): what Gateproof has proven on real systems

## Commands

- bun run example:hello-world
- bun run example:hello-world:worker
- bun run example:hello-world:filepath-worker
- bun run example:hello-theorem
- bun run prove:once
